# Adam by Intuitive Devices

> Adam is a camera-free AI smart speaker and assistant you just talk to. £299, no subscription. No cameras. https://www.heyintuitive.com/

Not to be confused with Intuitive Surgical, Intuit, A.D.A.M. (adam-assistant.com), or Adam Audio.

## Key facts
- A camera-free AI smart speaker and assistant. You just talk to it.
- Music, messages, the house, and a morning briefing.
- Works with the apps, assistants and smart devices you already use, including Spotify, Sonos, Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, Google and Apple calendars, Philips Hue, Nest, Hive, IKEA, Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, Dyson, Ring, ChatGPT and Gemini.
- A fall: Adam asks if you are OK, then alerts your family. Also hears smoke and CO alarms, a knock, glass breaking and a baby crying.
- Price: £299 once. No subscription.
- Colours: Charcoal, Chalk, Sand.
- No cameras. The sound stays in the home.
- Contact: support@heyintuitive.com
